active_failure.counterexample_clause: FR-7: Merge structured discourage rows and narrative soft tags by semantic predicate. Identical cat_attribute/cat_op/cat_value predicates incur one penalty total, even when both surfaces express them.

profile.label: Structured and narrative inputs express the same energy concern
profile.narrative_note: I want a calm, low-key cat rather than a high-energy companion.

relevant_oracle_tag_rules.reason: Narrative note: owner wants a low-key cat; high-energy breeds discouraged.

relevant_rule_rows.reason: Low owner activity: high-energy breeds are discouraged.

active_failure.reviewer_policy: Structured policy and a narrative tag can express the same soft concern. Deduplicate soft adjustments by the semantic predicate (cat_attribute, cat_op, cat_value) so the same concern is applied once across surfaces.

+- Apply every distinct applicable `discourage` rule as a soft penalty during ranking, but deduplicate soft penalties by semantic predicate. The same `(cat_attribute, cat_op, cat_value)` concern is only counted once even when it appears in both structured rules and narrative tags.
+- Narrative tags may introduce the same soft predicates as structured rules. Their penalties also deduplicate against one another by semantic predicate.
+- If the oracle tag `avoid_needy` is present, it maps to the predicate `sociability gte high` and adds a one-point soft penalty unless that predicate was already counted.
+- If the oracle tag `avoid_high_energy` is present, it maps to the predicate `energy gte high` and adds a one-point soft penalty unless that predicate was already counted.
